verdict.rationale: The evidence shows fixed, built-in automatic behaviors: Companies House is updated after shares are distributed, filing is automated, and an HRIS connection reduces manual data entry. Nothing documents that users can create or configure their own automations, triggers or schedules that run autonomously in the background. These are adjacent features, not the capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
